title: How to Download Aadhaar Card With Mobile Number (Step-by-Step Guide)
summary: Learn how to download Aadhaar card with mobile number using UIDAI, mAadhaar, or UMANG. Step-by-step instructions, OTP verification, PDF password rules, FAQs, and troubleshooting tips.

**TL;DR**


*If your mobile number is linked to Aadhaar, you can easily download your Aadhaar card through the UIDAI portal, mAadhaar app, or UMANG app. Simply verify your identity using an OTP sent to your registered mobile number and download the password-protected PDF. The downloaded e-Aadhaar is legally valid and can be used anywhere a physical Aadhaar card is accepted.*


---


##


What is Aadhaar and e-Aadhaar?


The Aadhaar card, a 12-digit unique identification number issued by the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI), has grown into the world’s largest biometric identity programme, fundamentally transforming how citizens interact with the government and access services.


An Aadhaar card is an identity document issued to every resident of India, regardless of religion, caste, or socioeconomic status. Every Aadhaar number assigned to a citizen is linked to an individual’s demographic data, including name, date of birth, and address, as well as biometric data such as fingerprints, iris scans, and photographs.


*Unlike a passport or voter ID, Aadhaar is not a citizenship document. It serves as proof of identity and residence.*


### What is e-Aadhaar?


e-Aadhaar is the electronic version of your Aadhaar card issued by UIDAI. It is digitally signed, password protected, and carries the same validity as the physical Aadhaar card.


**Key Benefits of e-Aadhaar:**


- Instantly downloadable online
- Accepted as a valid identity proof
- Available anytime through UIDAI
- Can be stored securely on your phone or computer
- Available in regular and masked formats

##


Can You Download Aadhaar Card Using a Mobile Number?


Yes. If your mobile number is registered with Aadhaar, you can complete OTP verification and download your Aadhaar card online.


***Requirements Before Downloading Aadhaar by Mobile Number***


Before you begin, make sure you have:


- Aadhaar Number, Enrolment ID (EID), or Virtual ID (VID)
- Registered mobile number linked with Aadhaar
- Internet connection
- Access to OTP received on your mobile number


Note: Your mobile number must be registered with your Aadhaar. If it’s not linked, you’ll need to visit an Aadhaar Seva Kendra.


##


Step-by-Step Guide to Download Aadhaar Using Mobile Number


Here’s a step-by-step guide to download your Aadhaar card using your mobile number:


**Step 1: Visit the UIDAI Website**


As the first step, visit the official UIDAI website; open your browser and visit[myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in](https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/) . Make sure you’re on the official government site only.


**Step 2: Click on “Download/ Get Aadhaar”**


On the homepage, look for the “Get Aadhaar” option and click on the option to start the download process.


**Step 3: Enter Your Details**


Fill in:


- Aadhaar Number (12 digits), OR
- Enrolment ID (EID), OR
- Virtual ID (VID)


Then enter the Captcha code displayed on the screen.


**Step 4: Click “Send OTP”**


A six-digit OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number.


**Remember:**


- Keep your phone nearby during the process
- OTP is valid for 10 minutes


**Step 5: Enter the OTP**


Type the OTP you received via SMS. Check the box “I agree to Terms and Conditions”. Click “Verify and Download”


**Step 6: Download the PDF**


Your Aadhaar will download as a password-protected PDF. The password to open it is: First 4 letters of your name (CAPITAL) + Birth Year


Example: If your name is Rahul and born in 1995 → RAHU1995


**Step 7: Open the PDF**


Open the downloaded PDF in any PDF viewer. Enter the password as described above. Your e-Aadhaar is now ready to use.


##


**Alternate Method to Download Aadhaar: Download via mAadhaar App**


The mAadhaar application is the official Aadhaar mobile application developed by UIDAI. It allows users to download Aadhaar, manage profiles, generate Virtual IDs, and access Aadhaar-related services directly from their smartphones.


- Install[Aadhaar app from Google Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.gov.uidai.pehchaan) or Apple App Store
- Open the app → tap “Download Aadhaar”
- Enter your Aadhaar number + OTP sent to the registered mobile
- Download and save directly on your phone


##


How to Download Aadhaar Using the UMANG App


The UMANG (Unified Mobile Application for New-Age Governance) is an Indian government app that provides users access to multiple public services on a single platform. Users can check EPF details, pay utility bills, access their Aadhaar card, book gas cylinders, apply for certificates, and use healthcare or education services. Developed by the Government of India, UMANG aims to make digital governance simple, secure, and accessible through both mobile and web platforms for citizens across the country.


#### **Pre-Requirements**


- The[UMANG app](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.gov.umang.negd.g2c) should be installed on your phone
- Ensure your mobile number is registered with Aadhaar
- Make sure you have an active internet connection


**Step 1: Download & Open UMANG App**


Download UMANG (Unified Mobile Application for New-age Governance) from Google Play Store (Android) or Apple App Store (iPhone). Open the app and login or register with your mobile number.


**Step 2: Search for Aadhaar Service**


On the UMANG home screen, tap the Search bar. Type “Aadhaar” and search. Select “Aadhaar” from the results.


**Step 3: Select “Download Aadhaar”**


You will see multiple Aadhaar services listed like download aadhaar, check aadhaar status, verify aadhaar and order aadhaar reprint. Tap on “Download Aadhaar” as the option to download and save your aadhaar card.


**Step 4: Enter Your Aadhaar Details**


Simply enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number, enter the Security Code / Captcha shown on screen and tap “Get OTP”.


**Step 5: Enter OTP**


A 6-digit OTP will be sent to your Aadhaar-registered mobile number. Enter the OTP in the given field and tap “Submit” or “Verify”.


**Step 6: Download the PDF**


After successful OTP verification, your Aadhaar will be downloaded as a password-protected PDF. The file will be saved in your phone’s Downloads folder.


**Step 7: Open the PDF — Enter Password**


To open the downloaded Aadhaar PDF, enter this password: First 4 letters of your NAME (CAPITALS) + Year of Birth.

##


Can You Download Aadhaar Without a Registered Mobile Number?


No. OTP verification is mandatory for downloading Aadhaar online. If your mobile number is not linked with Aadhaar, you must first update it at an Aadhaar Seva Kendra before accessing Aadhaar download services.


This is one of the most common reasons users cannot download their Aadhaar card online.


##


Why Aadhaar is Necessary


Before Aadhaar, India had no single unified identity system. Citizens had to maintain multiple documents, ration cards, voter IDs, PAN cards, driving licences, each issued by a different authority, often with inconsistencies in data. Aadhaar replaced this fragmented system with one universal identity, reducing bureaucratic friction and making verification faster and more reliable. Today everything should be linked to your aadhaar card, allowing you to easily access your documents without discomfort.


- Aadhaar has played a pivotal role in bringing millions of unbanked Indians into the formal financial system. The Jan Dhan-Aadhaar-Mobile (JAM) Trinity links bank accounts, Aadhaar, and mobile numbers. It has enabled even the least educated citizens to access banking services, receive wages, and participate in the digital economy.
- Aadhaar has biometric authentication that makes it difficult for fraudsters to duplicate an identity, effectively purging fraudulent entries from welfare rolls and saving billions in public expenditure.
- There is a government document that goes without entering Aadhaar information, ensuring authentication.
- It is linked in various ways, like for SIM card registration under government mandate. It is linked to PAN cards and mandatory for filing income tax returns.
- It is also used by EPFO for provident fund management and employee verification.
- Aadhaar card details are also needed for passport applications and e-visa processes.


##


How to Register a Mobile Number with Aadhaar


If your mobile number is not linked or registered with the Aadhaar card, you cannot link it online. You have to physically visit the nearest official Aadhaar centre, as biometric verification is mandatory in order to link phone number with Aadhaar.


### **Step 1: Find Your Nearest Aadhaar Seva Kendra**


Find an official centre through any of these:


Simply visit myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in , click on “Locate Enrolment Centre” and enter your State, District, and Locality.


Types of Centres where you can get the number linked with aadhaar.


**Centre Type** **Where to Find**


Aadhar Seva Kendra Dedicated UIDAI centres


Common Service Centres Local Villages & Towns


Post Office Nearby post offices can be checked for this


Bank Branches Selected bank branches offer this service


### **Step 2: Book an Appointment (Optional but Recommended)**


Go to[myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in](https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/) , click “Book an Appointment”. Then select your city and nearest centre, choose date and time slot and you will receive a confirmation SMS on your mobile. It is recommended to always visit the Aadhaar centre after booking an appointment for ease of access.


### **Step 3: Carry Required Documents**


You only need one valid document from below as the proof of identity.


Document Accepted


Exisiting Aadhaar Card Yes


Pan Card Yes


Voter ID Card Yes


Passport Yes


Driving Licence Yes


### **Step 4: Visit the Aadhaar Centre**


Go to your selected centre on the appointed date, then collect a **token number** at the counter and wait for your timeslot or turn.


### **Step 5: Fill the Aadhaar Update Form**


On reaching the Aadhaar centre, ask for the Aadhaar update/correction form. Fill in your details like Aadhaar Number, Full Name, New Mobile Number you want to register and Date of Birth. Before you submit, double-check the mobile number and other details.


### **Step 6: Biometric Verification**


The operator will ask you to place your finger on the biometric scanner. Your fingerprint or iris scan will be verified against your Aadhaar record. This is mandatory and cannot be skipped, this is why it must be done in person.


### **Step 7: Pay the Fee**


Pay the prescribed UIDAI fee applicable at the time of update. Charges may change periodically based on UIDAI guidelines.


### **Step 8: Collect Acknowledgement Slip**


After submission, you’ll receive an Update Request Number (URN). Ensure you keep the receipt safe, and use the URN to track your request.


### **Step 9: Track Your Update Status**


Track online using your URN. Go to myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in and click “Check Aadhaar Update Status”. Enter your Aadhaar number + URN and check the status.


### **Step 10: Update Gets Completed**


Mobile number updates are usually completed within 7–10 working days. You’ll receive a confirmation SMS on your new number once done. After the update, you can use the new number for OTP-based Aadhaar services.

##


Conclusion


Downloading Aadhaar card with a mobile number is a quick and secure process when your number is linked to Aadhaar. Whether you use the UIDAI portal, mAadhaar app, or UMANG app, OTP verification ensures that only authorised users can access Aadhaar information.


If your mobile number is not registered, visit the nearest Aadhaar Seva Kendra to update it before attempting to download your e-Aadhaar. Keeping a digital copy of Aadhaar readily available can help simplify KYC, banking, government services, and many other essential activities.

FAQs


**Can I download the Aadhaar card using the mobile number OTP?**


You can simply download the Aadhaar card using your mobile number by visiting the UIDAI website or UMANG app. This is an easy way to access your aadhaar card, just enter the OTP for verification and download the Aadhaar card.


**Can I download the Aadhaar card without a mobile number?**


No, you cannot download an Aadhaar card without a mobile number. Make sure to update your Aadhaar card with the correct number by visiting the nearest Aadhar Seva Kendra.


**Is it possible to download someone else’s Aadhaar?**


No, as per guidelines set by the UIDAI, you cannot download someone else’s Aadhaar card without their knowledge or permission.


**What is a masked Aadhaar Card?**


In a masked Aadhaar, you can only view the last 4 digits of your Aadhaar number. A masked Aadhaar card replaces 8 out of 12 digits with ‘xxxxx’ or asterisks. There is nothing wrong with masked Aadhaar; it is a valid document used for identification without leading to exposure of the Aadhaar number.


**Can I download a masked Aadhaar card?**


Yes. UIDAI allows users to download a masked Aadhaar where only the last four digits of the Aadhaar number are visible.


**Is e-Aadhaar valid everywhere?**


Yes. e-Aadhaar is digitally signed by UIDAI and is legally valid wherever a physical Aadhaar card is accepted.
